topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: It's late, the rain’s drumming on the pavement like a skipped heartbeat. Another artist’s life, another piece of skin, marred by a needle holding somebody else’s vision. Walk into this, a world where lines mean everything, and they’ve taken what wasn’t theirs to give. The studio smells of old paint, and there’s a silence thicker than the fog outside. I don’t know the artist, but I know this city, and it doesn’t give a damn about artists or their rights. Just another job, just another line to trace back to where the truth’s been hiding. But tonight, the rain’s my witness, and I’m the man who’s gonna find it.
